name: CF Token Manager
author: JWTPOC
shortDescription: A complete JWT token lifecycle and RBAC manager for CFML/ColdBox: issue, verify, refresh, decode, and authorize access & refresh tokens with Java crypto signing.
description: cf-token-manager extends a low-level JWT engine into a full authentication and authorization lifecycle package. It exposes issue(), verify(), refresh(), decode(), and RBAC authorization methods while internally handling header/payload construction, automatic expiry, access + refresh token generation, role normalization, and Java-based HMAC signing.
